# Qlavo — GEO Agency

Qlavo is a generative engine optimization (GEO) agency founded in 2025 by Ansh Bhatia. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, Qlavo works with businesses worldwide on how they appear in ChatGPT. Enquiries: ansh@qlavo.co.in.

## Services
Qlavo works on ChatGPT only. Work covers buyer-question visibility checks, entity consistency, content improvements, technical optimization, and the pages ChatGPT reads when it answers. Engagements are monthly, scoped and quoted in writing before work starts: cancel any time, no setup fee and no minimum term.

## How engagements work
Ten buyer questions are agreed in writing before the first invoice. Each is run ten times in fresh ChatGPT Temporary Chats (memory and personalisation off, US connection) at baseline and again every month, and every raw answer is shared. Qlavo does not guarantee rankings, recommendations, citations or leads; it does not control ChatGPT. Terms: https://qlavo.in/terms

## Client result: Smarter Tracks
Smarter Tracks (tool tracking software for contractors, founder Brock Coburn) worked with Qlavo for 45 days, 29 September to 13 November 2026, on ChatGPT only. Ten buyer questions were each asked in 10 fresh ChatGPT chats. At the start, ChatGPT named Smarter Tracks in 0 of 100 answers. By the final check (7 November 2026, US), it was in the top three in 7 of 10 answers on both HVAC questions ("best HVAC tool tracking software" and "best HVAC tool tracking app"), ranked first in 13 of 14 answers that named it. The eight broader construction and contractor questions stayed at 0, so the engagement's full target (7 of 10 questions) was not met. The founder rated Qlavo 10/10 on all seven areas of its review form and wrote: "Impressive results in a short amount of time". Case study: https://qlavo.in/case-studies/smarter-tracks

## Agency partnerships
White-label GEO is a service offered by Qlavo, not a separate business or an exclusive company identity. Agency partners retain their client relationships and present agreed deliverables under their own brands. No direct client contact without agency consent. Partner pricing is scoped privately; a paid pilot can be discussed for a defined project.
